notes: ὁμότεχνον → 'of the same trade' heads on 'trade'; heading on 'same' remains defensible if the ὁμο- element is read as the distinctive one, but rule 66 prefers the noun glossing the lexeme's nominal core.
τῇ τέχνῃ: no genitive pronoun stands to take the supplied 'their', so the article realizes it under rule 20's second arm with the case preposition riding along per rule 21.
εἶναι keeps its supplied subject 'he' under rule 74, the subject being an argument of the infinitive rather than of the governing preposition's clause.
